title: Kalag-kalag visitors in Mandaue City's cemeteries exceed 46,000

blocks.text: Individuals visit St. Joseph Catholic Cemetery in Barangay Guizo, Mandaue City, on Monday morning, November 2.| CDN Digital Photo/Mary Rose Sagarino MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — More than 46,000 individuals visited eight cemeteries in Mandaue City for All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. Data from the Mandaue City Police Office (MCPO) showed that 2,270 individuals visited the cemeteries on Friday, October 30, followed by 6,133 on October 31. The number of visitors peaked on Sunday, November 1, with 34,477 recorded.
